questions.prompt: Which fact is introduced first in Day and Night?
choices: The Sun lights one half of Earth.
The side turned from the Sun has night.
Earth keeps turning. Day comes back.
questions.answer: The Sun lights one half of Earth.
questions.evidenceText: The Sun lights one half of Earth.

questions.prompt: What does Earth do all day and night?
choices: Earth turns all day and all night.
Earth stops all day and all night.
Earth shrinks all day and all night.
questions.answer: Earth turns all day and all night.
questions.evidenceText: Earth turns all day and all night.

questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Day and Night?
choices: Earth keeps turning. Day comes back.
Only the Sun lights one half of Earth.
Only the side turned from the Sun has night.
questions.answer: Earth keeps turning. Day comes back.
questions.rationale: The Sun lights one half of Earth. The side turned from the Sun has night. Earth keeps turning. Day comes back. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Earth keeps turning. Day comes back.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: The Sun lights one half of Earth.
The side turned from the Sun has night.
